purpose: Preserve credential wording, status and evidence boundaries before public profile changes.
rules: Do not silently normalize or translate an official credential title.
USER_STATED wording is preserved until checked against the credential.
USER_CONFIRMED corrections may replace stale public wording, but must not be relabeled as independent documentary verification.
ONGOING programmes must not be displayed as completed.
When current-public wording and new user wording differ, status is RECONCILE_BEFORE_PUBLIC_CHANGE unless the account owner explicitly resolves the public wording.
